title: Add staff to redeem
summary: Let whoever works your counter redeem Tikkas, without seeing your leads.

steps.title: Open Team
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Team. On a computer, go to Settings, then Team.

steps.title: Invite them
steps.body: Type their email address and tap "Send invite". Then send them the invite link on WhatsApp.

steps.title: They sign in
steps.body: They open the link and sign in with Google or an email and password. They go straight to Redeem.

tips: Staff can only redeem. They never see your leads or anyone's phone number.
To remove someone, open Team and tap Remove next to their name (it asks you to confirm).
